bundle.shortDescription: Local AI image and video generation.
bundle.longDescription: Mold generates images and video locally on your GPU — FLUX, SD, SDXL, SD3.5, Z-Image, Qwen-Image, LTX video and more — with a gallery, model manager, and multi-stage chain composer. Runs its engine in-process on Apple Silicon or connects to a remote mold server.
